kitDescription: Brid: Silent Track is a Fire-element shotgun Supporter on Burst II whose real job is pumping the team's attack. Her burst gives every ally except herself a flat attack boost worth 66.52% of her own attack for 10 seconds, which is the line that defines her value on a board. Her first skill fires every time the team enters Full Burst: it deals a 636% attack nuke to all enemies, and — only against Wind Code enemies — makes them take 15.12% more damage for 10 seconds. Her second skill runs off her own shooting: every 5 normal attacks she hits the lowest-HP enemy for 675% of her attack, and every 10 normal attacks she applies a 12.12% damage-taken debuff to the lowest-HP Wind Code enemy. Because both damage-taken debuffs are Wind-only, against the neutral/Fire scope-lock boss she is purely her burst buff plus the two damage riders; against a Wind boss she additionally becomes a stacking team-wide damage amplifier.

The blind test's independent form (stat must be 'casterAtkPct', emitted value flat and >500, never 66.52, targetSlug never the unit) passes against the driver's shipped override.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA survives. All 5 kit lines are FAITHFUL: the two Wind-gated Damage-Taken debuffs sit in the boss-side Taken bucket with the element scope composed WITH (not replacing) their real triggers, the two damage riders are correctly ungated function-type hits taking the FB major by landing time, and the burst is the caster-scaled flat ATK grant with excludeSelf — the latter corroborated independently by the datamined prefer_target_condition 'ExcludeSelf'. The single cross-family divergence — S6 blind hitCount 5/10 vs driver 50/100 — is a RECON-side open question the blind author explicitly flagged rather than asserted, and it resolves to the driver by two independent routes: sim.ts increments the hit counter by hitsPerShot (10) per shot, so '5 normal attacks' necessarily means threshold 50; and the 2026-07-16 solo read measured the rider firing exactly every 5th pull (43 = floor(215/5)) at exactly 675.00%. The blind's 5/10 would have fired ~10× too often, the largest quantitative trap on this unit, and the driver's test discriminates it explicitly. The unmodified S5 blind test is RED only at the file level and in three scaffolding respects (harness import path; a controlComp fixture where crown out-competes brid for the B2 cast slot, making every burst assertion vacuous; a 636:675 ratio assertion that wrongly assumed buff state cancels between the two riders) — none touch driver faithfulness; adapted, it runs 13 passed / 1 skipped, with the skip (Wind-boss ACTIVE case) covered directly by the driver's own Wind-boss run. Magnitudes 636 / 675 / 15.12 / 12.12 / 66.52 all match the level-10 datamined description_value lists exactly (tier DATAMINED), with the 675% additionally MEASURED. Same-model residual for owner spot-check, in priority order: (1) with brid as sole Burst II, fullBurstEnter and burstCast coincide ~1:1 and a skill-slot burstCast block also receives the FB major, so the driver's fixture discriminates skill1's trigger identity only weakly — the prose settles it, but a two-B2 comp would close the test-side gap; (2) the adapted 636:675 ratio check now reads the override's declared atkPct fields rather than end-to-end damage, so magnitude proportionality rests on the two halving tests; (3) her own SG spray/core damage remains the standing ⚑ (override FLAG c) — a magnitude debt on the weapon model, not a kit line, and out of this gate's scope.
